title: Limb Salvage In for Patients with Concomitant Advanced Malignancy
content: We are seeing an increasing number of patients with malignancy presenting with chronic limb threatening ischemia. With advancement in medicine, we need to have a shift in mindset towards this group of patients and provide a holistic approach when deciding treatment. In this original article, we highlight our approach in managing such patients and provide a suggested framework. We hope that with our article we bring about awareness and help vascular surgeons in managing such cases with improvement in quality of life for the patients.
